newsitem.title: UK: Euro LS fuel firm on US but St Petersburg sales loom.
newsitem.headline: Euro LS fuel firm on US but St Petersburg sales loom.

text.p: European fuel prices were mixed on Friday morning with low sulphur steady but prompt Rotterdam high sulphur barges down $1 a tonne.
"Anything loading before May 20 is under pressure," said trader who saw trade between $82 and $84 during the morning for that period.
Talk for any May was between $84.50 and $85 although trade for that period was thin.
Cargoes remained quiet but dealers saw growing exports from St Petersburg which might begin to impact prices over the next few weeks.
"We see about three cargoes on offer from St Petersburg," said a barge trader.
Demand from power companies in Europe remains subdued with price notionally around $85.50 cif Rotterdam.
"But if you want a good quality cargo you probably have to pay in the low $80s fob," said a broker.
Low sulphur remains well supported by big gains on the U.S. east coast where prices equivalent to $105 fob traded on Thursday.
European swaps were pegged around $95.50, slightly down from Thursday's highs but still some $10 above barges.
